text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I want to get back at everyone who made fun of me. I'm going to use my legs and my strength to shut them all up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …And if you get in my way, trainer or not, your butt's getting kicked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
